recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. issue_request: FHIR-7407 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that CarePlanActivityCategory not be required; the approved resolution demoted the activity category from 1..1 to 0..1 and changed the binding strength to example.

additional_context: CarePlan is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later Published CarePlan decisions moved beyond the DSTU1 category element: FHIR-10621 replaced CarePlan.activity.detail.category with detail.kind, and FHIR-39101 removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and its children from the active definition. The old care-plan-activity-category CodeSystem/ValueSet remains as standalone terminology but is not an active required CarePlan activity binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active XML tree for source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml lists CarePlan.activity, performedActivity, progress, and plannedActivityReference, and no CarePlan activity category path.
